mada_b10_pic_catatan_v5.filosofi: V5.0 final: Mada = B10 PIC, Back-End Operasional & Lintas Fungsi. NO customer-facing. NO closing hook pojok. NO lead generation. TUGAS MURNI: operasional internal, approval, monitoring, coaching, audit, konsolidasi KPI.
alasan_final: V4 pattern: Mada = mixed role (operasional + closing hook pojok + handle front office). Result: bottleneck di approval, kerjaan operasional terbengkalai, closing rate tim turun karena Mada fokus handle 1 closing.
V5.0 fix: Mada full back-end, no customer-facing. Customer-facing di-pisah: Riza (lead gen), Yudi (closing), Novita (admin/CS).
B10 = Back-End Operational PIC. Angka 10 = kode internal untuk PIC back-end murni (vs P0-P3 = PIC operasional lain).
Decision: Mada punya delegation approve <= 5jt. Mada supervise 11 PIC via daily standup + KPI Score Card. Mada lead lintas fungsi via cross-divisi review mingguan.

definisi_final_mada.title: B10 PIC — Back-End Operasional & Lintas Fungsi (No Hook/Closing Pojok)
definisi_final_mada.scope: 12 PIC perusahaan, lintas divisi, lintas fungsi
termasuk: KPI Score Card consolidation + auto-report owner
Escalation ke Owner untuk > 5jt atau blocker strategic

wakil_jika_off_site.off_1_hari: Standup ditunda max 1 jam, Bu Nisya handle approval legal, Rizal handle approval proyek (jika urgent)
wakil_jika_off_site.off_2_3_hari: Bu Nisya acting chief of staff + Rizal site lead + Reni media lead. Triple lead sementara.
wakil_jika_off_site.off_lebih_3_hari: Pak Ardian turun tangan langsung + backup activated. Standup + KPI Score Card delegated ke Bu Nisya.

kompetensi_yang_dibutuhkan: Lintas fungsi: paham marketing + closing + proyek + admin + legal + media di level overview
Coaching: bisa coaching pakai 3 pilar (kurikulum + legitimasi moral + waktu fleksibel)
Decision making: bisa decide <= 5jt tanpa minta owner (sesuai delegation_matrix)
Konsolidasi: bisa rekap 12 PIC KPI jadi 1 dashboard
Komunikasi: sopan tapi tegas, tidak micromanage, tidak laissez-faire

sinta_stopper_kualitas_v5.filosofi: Purchasing V4 = quantity worker (banyak order, asal dapat material). Purchasing V5 = stopper kualitas - TIDAK ordering kalau material tidak sesuai spek, meskipun mandor pressure. Sinta = quality gate, BUKAN admin order.

qualifier_wajib.definisi: Cross-check spek: semen harus sesuai spek proyek (type, brand, mutu), besi harus sesuai diameter, kayu harus sesuai jenis. Tidak boleh 'mirip' atau 'hampir sama'.
Hitung volume real (tanpa waste), lalu tambahkan waste allowance maks 5%. Kalau waste aktual > 5% → Sinta tolak material, retensi vendor.
Track: berapa modal keluar (uang) vs berapa fisik jadi (unit/blok). Kalau money > value 20% → alert Rizal + Owner.
Cross-check volume netto (volume pakai) vs bruto (volume beli). Selisih normal 3-5%. Lebih dari itu = waste / bocor.
Setiap blok punya retensi 5% yang ditahan sampai 30 hari pasca BAST. Sinta track retensi release sesuai timeline.
Setiap PO > 500rb wajib 3 vendor quotation. Sinta tidak boleh langsung PO tanpa perbandingan, kecuali urgent (escalate Mada).

indikator_kualitas_keputusan.konsekuensi_jika_miss: Material reject + retensi vendor + Sinta coaching

wewenang_tambah.tolak_material_tidak_spes: Sinta BOLEH menolak material meskipun mandor/mandor proyek pressure. Wajib dokumentasi foto + spek + alasan.
wewenang_tambah.block_po_tanpa_3_vendor: Sinta BOLEH block PO > 500rb yang tidak ada 3 vendor quotation. Mada tidak boleh override tanpa escalation ke Owner.
wewenang_tambah.retensi_vendor_otomatis: Sinta otomatis retensi 5% ke vendor yang material reject / molor. Tidak perlu approval Mada.

sow_12_pic.title: Owner / Director
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Pemegang saham, strategic decision maker, final approval. Tanpa owner centris = Pak Ardian hanya turun tangan untuk keputusan > 50jt atau pivot bisnis. Operasional harian sudah didelegasikan ke Mada, legal ke Bu Nisya.
tugas_harian: Approve pengeluaran > 5jt (jika di luar delegation Mada)
tugas_mingguan: Review KPI Score Card seluruh PIC (auto-report setiap Jumat)

decision_authority.wakil: Bu Nisya + Mada (operasional saat owner off-site > 3 hari)

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Direct dari semua PIC via Mada atau Bu Nisya

sow_12_pic.title: Legal / Co-Director
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Legal oversight + kontrak + sengketa. Di V5.0, Bu Nisya punya delegation authority kontrak <= 50jt, lead audit front office mingguan, lead training legal utk admin polyvalent.
tugas_harian: Review kontrak masuk (closing FLPP, vendor baru)

decision_authority.scope: Kontrak FLPP, kontrak vendor <= 50jt, addendum, sengketa, legal opinion

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Pak Ardian untuk keputusan > 50jt atau pivot legal

sow_12_pic.title: B10 PIC - Back-End Operasional & Lintas Fungsi (No Hook/Closing Pojok)
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: V5.0 redefinisi: Mada = B10 PIC, BACK-END operasional murni, NO customer-facing. Mada handle lintas fungsi: monitoring 12 PIC, approval <= 5jt, daily standup, KPI tracking, audit cross-divisi. Sebelumnya Mada juga marketing lead - V5.0 itu dilepas ke Riza (digital) + Yudi (closing).
tugas_mingguan: Review KPI Score Card seluruh PIC (auto)
Coaching on-the-job ke PIC yang perlu support
tugas_bulanan: Review SOP enforcement (yang dipakai, yang tidak)
Adjust delegation matrix jika ada gap

decision_authority.scope: Pengeluaran operasional, vendor routine, fee closing, reimbursement, material proyek < 5jt

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Pak Ardian untuk > 5jt atau blocker strategic

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Digital Marketing & Lead Generation
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Lead digital murni: Meta Ads, content production, landing page, lead capture, hand-off ke Yudi. Fee media = closing-based, bukan posting-based. V5.0 target: lead quality > quantity.

decision_authority.scope: Ads budget harian, content production, design tools

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk budget > 1.5jt atau strategy pivot

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Closing + Front Desk
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Closing murni + front desk. Terima qualified lead dari Riza, follow up merayu (7 step script), handle walk-in, deal closing. V5.0: closing rate > presentation rate.

decision_authority.scope: Tidak ada budget authority. Semua diskon/promo escalate ke Mada.

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk diskon > 0, lead macet > 7 hari

sow_12_pic.title: Kepala Pelaksana + Kepala Perencanaan + PIC Utama Proyek
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Triple role proyek: site manager + strategic planner + PIC utama. Lead harian site mandor + subkon, RAB + schedule, accountable ke Owner untuk delivery. V5.0 tambah: report harian STB (3 wajib) + reminder notion.
deliverables: STB 3 wajib (report harian, Notion reminder, masa kadaluarsa)

decision_authority.scope: Material proyek urgent, transport proyek, fee tukang, klaim material < 3jt

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk material > 3jt atau blocker > 48 jam

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Proyek + Marketing Cover
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Cover harian Rizal + content creator. V5.0: tambah kemampuan polyvalent - bisa cover CS, KPP filing, legal draft ringan. Wakil proyek rutin + konten rutin.

decision_authority.scope: Tidak ada budget authority. Cover wakil.

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Admin + After-Sales
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Admin polyvalent: pemberkasan + after-sales + CS ringan + KPP filing. V5.0: gaji fixed (no potong), fee 'mel' 100-300rb per file closing. Bisa cover ke CS/KPP/Legal saat admin lain off.

decision_authority.scope: Tidak ada budget authority. Filing + customer service murni.

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk komplain > 24 jam atau legal issue

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Purchasing + Auditor Internal
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: V5.0 redefinisi: Purchasing = stopper kualitas, BUKAN quantity worker. Tanggung jawab: kualitas bangunan (spek material), kuantitas (volume + waste), progress per-blok (money-to-value), auditor netto/bruto, retensi per-blok, best price method (3 vendor minimal). Indikator: kualitas keputusan, bukan kuantitas pekerjaan.
tugas_harian: Best price check vendor (3 vendor minimal)
sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk material > 1.5jt atau vendor issue

sow_12_pic.title: Ketua Media + Brand Manager
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Lead tim media (Reni+Rifki+Reta). Brand consistency, content pillar (product knowledge, brand awareness, closing trigger), training tim media. V5.0: content = alat closing, fee = closing-based.

decision_authority.scope: Content production cost, design tools, talent fee < 1.5jt

sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Mada untuk budget > 1.5jt atau brand pivot

sow_12_pic.title: Ketua Kreatif (Desain + Video)
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: Lead produksi kreatif: desain (Canva/Adobe), video (CapCut/Premiere), copy. V5.0: hook 3 detik + CTA kuat + nomer WA clone 4455 untuk closing trigger.
deliverables: WA clone 4455 aktif di semua CTA
sow_12_pic.escalation_path: Reni untuk trend pivot atau budget > 500rb

sow_12_pic.title: PIC Operasional Media
sow_12_pic.definisi_peran: PIC operasional media: posting, scheduling, community management, basic desain. V5.0: community manager aktif + engagement harian.

decision_authority.scope: Tidak ada budget authority. Eksekusi posting + community.

PIC_back_end_only: Mada (V5.0: NO customer-facing, NO closing hook)
